5b3c2a56cbeb: The extension connects Chrome to a paired relay service so Ocean can control task tabs and tabs you hand over using the browser toolbar button. Ocean has a separate setting for allowed sites. Chrome's permissions are broader than this setting: the restriction is enforced at the app level, not by a separate Chrome sandbox.
4e251d1542c8: On request, the extension can read page text and structure, URLs, tab titles, screenshots and field values; click elements, enter text and manage tabs. Pages may contain personal data, sign-in details, financial, medical and other sensitive information. The relay service also supports recording handed-over tabs on request. Website logins remain in your Chrome profile and are used through the normal browser session.
3b73e035d3c1: By default, the extension exchanges commands and results with a relay service on your computer. In advanced settings, you can specify a service of your choice on another computer. Use only a service and network you trust. Ocean may send page content and screenshots to the model provider selected for the task. That provider's terms and privacy policy then apply. The extension itself does not select the model provider.
476d63a24e6a: The extension has no advertising or analytics service and does not send browser data to an Ocean data-collection server. Browser data is used for the actions you request: it is not sold or used for advertising, profiling or unrelated purposes. Data use and transfer comply with the Chrome Web Store user data policy and Limited Use requirements.
fe71cbdac3e3: The extension saves pairing data and settings in Chrome extension storage. Relay service access data and Ocean task records are stored separately.
